shortDescription: Manage volume resource only policies in PX-Backup

options.name: csi_drivers
options.description: List of CSI drivers that need to be used to skip the backing up of volume data

options.name: enumerate_options
options.description: Options for controlling enumeration behavior when listing volume resource only policies Used with INSPECT_ALL operation to filter and limit results All suboptions are optional and can be combined for advanced filtering

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the volume resource only policy

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the volume resource only policy Required for all operations except INSPECT_ALL

options.name: nfs_servers
options.description: List of NFS servers that need to be used to skip the backing up of volume data in the case of NFS volumes

options.name: operation
options.description: Operation to perform on the volume resource only policy - CREATE: creates a new volume resource only policy - UPDATE: modifies an existing volume resource only policy - DELETE: removes a volume resource only policy - INSPECT_ONE: retrieves details of a specific volume resource only policy - INSPECT_ALL: lists all volume resource only policies - UPDATE_OWNERSHIP: updates ownership settings of a volume resource only policy

options.name: ownership
options.description: Ownership configuration for the volume resource only policy

options.name: ssl_config
options.description: SSL configuration dictionary containing certificate settings Contains validate_certs, ca_cert, client_cert, and client_key options If not provided, defaults to standard SSL verification

options.name: uid
options.description: Unique identifier of the volume resource only policy

options.name: volume_types
options.description: List of volume types to be skipped for backing up the volume data
